info.name: dgt-assessment
info.description:
Laravel e-commerce API for the DGT assessment.

## Setup

1. `php artisan migrate --seed`
2. `php artisan serve`
3. Set `base_url` to `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/` (trailing slash required — URLs are `{{base_url}}auth/login`).
4. Run **auth / login**. The test script stores `access_token` in `auth_token`.

## Seeded users

| Email | Password | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `admin@example.com` | `Password123` | admin |
| `customer@example.com` | `Password123` | customer |

## Envelope

Success: `{ "success": true, "message": ?string, "data": ... }`  
Error: `{ "success": false, "message": string, "code": string, "errors"?: object, "details"?: object }`

Money fields are **strings** with 2 decimals (`"120.00"`). Client `price` / `total` fields are ignored.

## Auth

Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`.  
Register/login optional header `X-Cart-Token` adopts a guest cart.

Rate limits: auth 5/min per email+IP and 20/min per IP; promotions 10/min; checkout/pay/cancel 10/min per customer.

## Guest cart

`GET /cart` without a token mints `X-Cart-Token` (UUID). Send it on later cart calls. Logged-in users use their account cart instead.

## Checkout

Requires Sanctum. Body must include `shipping`. Send `Idempotency-Key` so retries return the original order (200) instead of a second one. Unpaid `pending` orders expire after 30 minutes (`orders:expire-pending`).

item.name: auth
item.description: Register, login, current user, and logout. Login/register return `access_token`; store it as `auth_token`.

request.description:
Issue a Sanctum token. Email is trimmed and lowercased. Optional `device_name` (max 100). Optional `X-Cart-Token` adopts a guest cart.

**Rate limit:** 5/min per email+IP, 20/min per IP (`429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`).

**Errors:** `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `422 VALIDATION_FAILED`.

Revoke the current Bearer token only. Other devices stay signed in.

**Auth:** required.

**Errors:** `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.

Revoke every Sanctum token for this user. No body.

**Auth:** required.

**Errors:** `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`.

response.name: 200 Logged out everywhere

request.description:
Current user. Password is never returned. `role` is `customer` or `admin`.

**Auth:** required.

Always creates a **customer** (`role` in the body is ignored). Email unique, case-insensitive. Password: min 8, mixed case, letters and numbers, max 72 bytes, must match `password_confirmation`. Optional `device_name`. Optional `X-Cart-Token` adopts the guest cart.

**Errors:** `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` (duplicate email, weak password).

item.name: cart
item.description: Guest or authenticated cart. Guests: send `X-Cart-Token` (UUID) after the first `GET /cart`. Logged-in users ignore the token and use their account cart. Adding a line writes a 15-minute stock reservation; on-hand `stock_quantity` does not drop until checkout. Client prices are ignored. Quantity 1–1000.

header.description: Guest cart UUID. Optional when a Bearer token is present. GET /cart mints one and echoes it on the response.

request.description:
Load or create the cart. Guest without a token: mints `X-Cart-Token` on the response (also `data.cart_token`). Bearer without a guest token: user cart.

`checkout_ready` / `checkout_blocker` say whether `POST /checkout` will succeed. Copy `data.total` into checkout `expected_total`.

request.description:
Apply a code (trimmed, uppercased). Replaces any previous code. Rechecked at checkout.

Seeded: `SUMMER20` (20% cap 50, min 100), `WELCOME10`, `AUDIO10` (audio category), `SNKDEAL` (sneakers), `ONCEONLY` (already used by customer@example.com).

**Rate limit:** 10/min.

**Errors:** `422 CART_EMPTY`, `PROMOTION_INVALID`, `PROMOTION_INACTIVE`, `PROMOTION_NOT_STARTED`, `PROMOTION_EXPIRED`, `PROMOTION_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED`, `PROMOTION_CUSTOMER_LIMIT_REACHED`, `PROMOTION_MINIMUM_NOT_MET`, `PROMOTION_NOT_APPLICABLE`.

item.name: checkout
item.description: Logged-in customers only. Guests must register/login first. Stock is decremented here (not at pay). Send `expected_total` from GET /cart `data.total`. Shipping is snapshotted onto the order.

request.description:
Latest order's shipping snapshot for form prefill, or `data.shipping: null` if the user has never checked out. `POST /checkout` still requires a full `shipping` object.

**Auth:** required.

response.name: 200 Prefill

header.description: Optional, 8–100 chars. Same key + user returns the original order (200) instead of creating another.

request.description:
Create an order from the cart. Requires `checkout_ready`.

`expected_total` is required: copy `GET /cart` `data.total`. It confirms the last displayed payable total (integer cents). It is not the amount billed — `price` / `subtotal` / `total` in the body are ignored.

If the catalog or a still-valid promo moved, **409 `PRICE_CHANGED`** (no order). Retry with `details.current_total`. Idempotent replay (**200**) does not re-check the quote.

**201** new order (`pending`, `payment_due_at` ~30 min). **200** `Order already placed.`

**Rate limit:** 10/min.

**Errors:** `401`, `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` / `CART_EMPTY` / promo errors, `409 PRICE_CHANGED` / `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`.

**Errors:** `403`, `422 INVALID_ORDER_STATUS` (processing/shipped/delivered).

item.name: admin
item.description: Sanctum + `role:admin`. Customers get `403 FORBIDDEN`. Soft-delete products/promotions; restore brings them back. Price/stock and promotion commercial fields write append-only audit rows.

item.name: categories
item.description: Admin category CRUD. `parent_id` must be a root category (one level of nesting).

request.description: All root categories with children, including inactive.

`slug` is generated from `name` if omitted. Unique slug.

**201** Category created.
One category by id, with children.
Partial update. A category with children cannot become a subcategory.
Delete a category.

item.name: products
item.description: Admin product CRUD. Soft-delete hides from the storefront. Price and stock_quantity changes write audits.

request.description: Paginated, includes inactive. Newest first.

SKU is uppercased. Unique SKU. `status` defaults to active.

**201** Product created.
One product including inactive.
Partial update. Changing `price` or `stock_quantity` appends an audit row (source `admin`). Checkout stock moves do **not** audit.
Soft-delete. Storefront returns 404 until restore.
Restore a soft-deleted product.
Append-only price/stock history for this product.

item.name: promotions
item.description: Admin promotion CRUD. Soft-delete. `scope`: `order` | `products` (needs `product_ids`) | `categories` (needs `category_ids`). Percentage value ≤ 100.

request.description: Paginated, 15 per page, newest first.

Code is normalized (uppercase). Soft-deleted codes stay reserved — restore instead of recreating.

**201** Promotion created.
One promotion with `product_ids` / `category_ids`.
Partial update. Commercial field changes write promotion audits. `usage_limit` cannot be below `used_count`.
Soft-delete.
Restore a soft-deleted promotion.
Append-only commercial-field history for this promotion.

item.name: orders
item.description: All customers' orders. Fulfilment is forward-only: pending → paid → processing → shipped → delivered. Cannot skip. Cannot cancel here — use `POST /orders/{id}/cancel` so stock is restored.

query.description: Order number, customer email, or customer name.

request.description: Paginated. Each row embeds `customer`.
Full order plus `allowed_statuses` (next legal admin PATCH values).

One step along the fulfilment path. Stamps `paid_at` / `processing_at` / `shipped_at` / `delivered_at` once.

**Errors:** `422 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION` (skip or same status), `422` if `status=cancelled` (must use customer cancel endpoint).

item.name: audits
item.description: Global append-only logs. Product audits: `price`, `stock_quantity`. Promotion audits: code, type, scope, value, limits, dates, is_active.

request.description: Global product price/stock audit log.
Global promotion commercial-field audit log.
